visual_review.visible_evidence: At 3.033s (target_0), the operator is holding the adapter plate and rotor assembly, beginning to align them. By 4.033s (target_3), the adapter plate is being fitted onto the rotor shaft. In contrast, the rotor assembly is already in hand and being manipulated as part of this initial step; the distinct action of installing the rotor assembly (as shown in training reference action_demo_3) appears to occur later or is part of the same initial handling, but the explicit attachment of the adapter plate is the first distinguishable assembly action shown in the sequence starting at 3.033s.
limitations: The distinction between 'installing rotor assembly' and 'attaching adapter plate' can be subtle as they involve the same components; however, the visual sequence shows the adapter plate being actively fitted onto the rotor shaft starting at the earliest timestamp.
